notes: Added remaining required stories for FEAT-2 covering core logic, API integration, testing, and provider search integration.

stories.title: Implement Specialty Mapping Core Logic
stories.description: Implement core specialty identification logic using dual-pipeline approach (regex + vector search) with AI query expansion and NUCC code aggregation, deduplication, and classification.

stories.title: Expose Specialty Identification via Facade/API
stories.description: Integrate specialty identification into FindCare facade and tool routing layer, enabling API/tool access for mapping user queries to NUCC codes during provider search flows.

stories.title: Integrate Specialty Mapping with Provider Search
stories.description: Connect specialty identification output to provider search service, ensuring NUCC codes are correctly applied for taxonomy filtering and fallback logic during search execution.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Specialty Identification
stories.description: Create unit tests for specialty_service logic and integration tests validating end-to-end flow from user query to NUCC code output and provider search usage.
